title: Best Law Firm Georgia Award for 2013 goes to DLA Piper
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html:
DLA Piper has been named ‘Best Law Firm, Georgia, 2013’ by CFI.

Founded as a local firm, it is now uniquely well positioned to provide international expertise as well as demonstrate in- depth understanding of the jurisdiction. The majority of the firm’s work is for international clients and sophisticated Georgian businesses. Training of lawyers is a continuous process at the heart of the success of this outstanding Georgian legal firm.
